in_sanskrit.name: काव्यप्रिय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who loves poetry, a connoisseur of fine literature

in_marathi.name: Kavyapriya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lover of Poetry
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kavyapriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'kāvya' (poetry) and 'priya' (lover), Kavyapriya signifies a person who admires and enjoys poetry.

in_bengali.name: Kavyapriya
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lover of Poetry
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kavyapriya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'kāvya' (poetry) and 'priya' (lover), Kavyapriya signifies a person who admires and enjoys poetry.
